---
title: Guide one
_quarto:
  # Breadcrumbs, the active sidebar entry and page navigation all need
  # the project index, which a per-file smoke render lacks.
  render-project: true
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # GH #1297 (bd-erecx4j8, bd-eczdzfqo): every nav landmark has a
        # distinct accessible name, matching Quarto 1 (quarto-cli #14813),
        # and only the in-page TOC is a doc-toc. With a navbar, the
        # navbar is "Site" and the sidebar is "Section".
        - - 'nav.navbar[aria-label="Site"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-secondary-nav[aria-label="Toolbar"]'
          - 'nav.quarto-page-breadcrumbs[aria-label="Breadcrumbs"]'
          - 'nav#quarto-sidebar[aria-label="Section"]'
          - 'nav#TOC[role="doc-toc"][aria-labelledby="toc-title"]'
          - 'h2#toc-title'
          - 'nav.page-navigation[aria-label="Page"]'
        - - 'nav:not([aria-label]):not([aria-labelledby])'
          - '#quarto-sidebar[role]'
          - '[role="doc-toc"]:not(#TOC)'
---
